issue.title: Extend incremental Agents refresh to Status grouping
issue.description: Proposed by sase-127.4 note 3 after the active-filter flicker fix was verified. Status grouping still takes the display_fallback: unsupported_grouping full-rebuild path under live refreshes, while Standard, Machine, and the verified Project-grouping path avoid steady-state rebuilds when membership is unchanged. Determine the Status-panel safety invariants, admit BY_STATUS to the incremental diff path when the rendered widget tree and panel membership are stable, retain a full rebuild for real status-bucket membership changes, and add focused/perf regression coverage.

task_type_fields.proposal: Allow stable Status-grouped Agents views to use the incremental display diff path instead of rebuilding all panels on every refresh; preserve rebuilds when status bucket membership actually changes and cover both cases.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-127 fixed active-search rebuilds, load-tier oscillation, and duplicate fleet repaints. Its approved acceptance explicitly covered the stable-query path and observed Status grouping as a pre-existing unsupported-grouping limitation, not as a regression caused by the epic.
